description: National Refinery Limited was founded in 1963, came under government management in 1972 and was acquired by the Attock Group in 2005 after a competitive privatisation. It operates a 70,000 barrel-per-day refining complex in Karachi's Korangi industrial area and describes itself as the only refinery in Pakistan producing lube base oils and the only one running a BTX petrochemical plant. It also produces EURO-V compliant high-speed diesel and JP-1 and JP-8 aviation fuels, and says it makes more than 27 product categories.
sourceNote: Company website (nrlpak.com: home, who-we-are/our-profile, who-we-are/our-leadership, contact), read 2026-10-17.

products.name: Fuel products
products.summary: Motor gasoline and high-speed diesel to the PAK-V standard, JP-1 and JP-8 aviation jet fuels, LPG, naphtha and kerosene.

products.name: Lube base oils
products.summary: API Group-I lube base oils — spindle, light, medium and heavy neutrals and Bright Stock — the company states it is Pakistan's only producer.

products.name: Bitumen
products.summary: Paving grades 40/50, 60/70 and 80/100 for highways and runways, exported to the Middle East, Europe and Asia.

products.name: Speciality petrochemicals
products.summary: Slack wax, BTX aromatics from the country's only BTX plant, solvent oil, sulphur and rubber process oil.
